notes.title: NEW FEATURES!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, I added new features to the game! 

New Features Added:

Decorating
- Furniture Placing
- Furniture Selling

Complete control over the look of your kitchen with complete customization and tons of new furniture to come!

Day and Night Cycle
- Time Clock

I added a day night cycle to push the player through out the day during gameplay and give you all plenty of reasons to buy cool lighting for the boat! :D

Updated Fishing Mini Game

I updated the fishing mini game since the announcement to add more player input to the whole fishing process! More to come....

OVERALL THOUGHTS

I am still adding a ton more features to the game and am planning to get a demo out ASAP! I am working on the game as much as possible and am adding to it everyday!

Signing off,
Seth
